title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill Spearmint 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Elevate your vaping experience with Doozy Vape Co's Seriously Pod Fill's Spearmint, a unique e-liquid that sets itself apart by focusing on one signature flavour: spearmint. From the moment you take the first inhale, the rejuvenating taste of spearmint fills your mouth, reminiscent of a stick of spearmint gum or a fresh cup of mint tea. The spearmint essence offers a naturally sweet undertone, allowing the vape to be refreshing yet not overpowering. Soon after, a subtle cooling sensation joins the mix, amplifying the freshness and adding an extra dimension to your vape. This cooling effect is subtle, not like a menthol blast, but more akin to a gentle breeze that caresses your senses as you exhale. It’s almost therapeutic, offering a sensation that is both calming and uplifting at the same time. Ideal for those who prefer a straightforward yet memorable flavour profile, Spearmint offers an experience that is minty, sweet, and perfectly balanced. It's not just an excellent palate cleanser, but also a fantastic all-day vape for those who want to keep things simple yet satisfying. It's the kind of e-liquid you can turn to at any time, for any occasion, and it will never disappoint. Discover unparalleled vaping bliss with Doozy Vape Co's Seriously Pod Fills. Boasting ten mouth-watering, double-concentrated flavours, these e-liquids are expertly crafted to tantalise your taste buds while keeping nicotine cravings at bay. Unique in their 50/50 VG/PG blend, Pod Fills are versatile, ideal for Starter Kits , MTL Pod Kits , and devices with coils of 0.8ohm or higher. Enjoy the convenience of a 100ml shortfill bottle, complete with 20ml of extra space for your preferred nicotine shot. For instance, add 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots to create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid.
